parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (1.0081) as it regressed from my best (1.0043). It seems the recent change added noise or instability. Reverting to my best config (DEPTH=6, AR=48, LR=0.025, BS=524288, WARMUP=0.1, WD=0.0) and will now test adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.05 to stabilize.
